basics.type: State private university established by Punjab Act No. 11 of 2025, sponsored by the Chandigarh Educational Society
basics.ugc: Recognised under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956
basics.other: Grew out of Chandigarh Group of Colleges, Jhanjeri (founded 2012), which was accredited NAAC A+ (CGPA 3.46). Engineering, management, computing, law, liberal arts, health sciences, pharmacy and more

admission: Class 12 with Physics, Maths, Chemistry or another listed subject; 60% (55% for reserved categories)
CGCUET (CGC University's entrance and scholarship test) is required for B.Tech CSE and its specialisations; JEE Main and CUET scores also count for scholarships
CGC University admission process; scholarships through CGCUET, JEE Main or CUET

scholarships.text: Scholarships of up to 100% on CGCUET score, JEE Main rank (B.Tech) or CUET percentile.

hostel.text: On-campus hostels; the hostel fee includes mess charges, and residents can use the gym free.

fees.text: CGC University lists fees programme-wise. Ask us for the current fee for your course.

desc: CGC University, Mohali (Jhanjeri): B.Tech admission through CGCUET, JEE Main or CUET, eligibility, scholarships up to 100%, hostels and free guidance.
